t: The Portuguese founded Rio in 1565 after driving out a French colony on an island in Guanabara Bay, and the city became the colonial capital in 1763, when the administration moved from Salvador.
In 1808 the Portuguese royal court fled Napoleon's invasion and settled in Rio, which stayed the capital through the Empire of Brazil and the Republic until Brasília replaced it in 1960.
Rio was a city of enslaved people: between 1811 and 1831 half a million to a million enslaved people arrived through the Valongo Wharf, and its port was the largest slave port in the Americas.
dyk: When the Portuguese court arrived in 1808, Rio became the only European capital outside Europe, and many of its inhabitants were evicted from their homes to house the arriving nobles.
ev: A Portuguese expedition reaches Guanabara Bay on 1 January and gives the place its name
French colonists under Villegaignon occupy an island in the bay and found France Antarctique
Estácio de Sá founds the city of São Sebastião do Rio de Janeiro
The colonial administration of Portuguese America moves from Salvador to Rio
The Portuguese royal court arrives in Rio, fleeing Napoleon's invasion of Portugal
Prince Pedro proclaims the independence of Brazil and keeps Rio as the capital of the new empire
Mayor Pereira Passos begins the reforms that rebuild the city centre
The capital of Brazil moves from Rio to Brasília

f.founded: Founded on 1 March 1565 by the Portuguese, led by Estácio de Sá, as São Sebastião do Rio de Janeiro; Europeans had first reached Guanabara Bay on 1 January 1502.
f.where: On the Atlantic coast of south-eastern Brazil, at the entrance to Guanabara Bay, marked by Sugar Loaf, in the state of Rio de Janeiro.
f.known: The French colony of France Antarctique and its expulsion; the colonial port for Minas Gerais gold; the Valongo Wharf and the slave trade; seat of the Portuguese court from 1808; capital of the Empire and then of the Republic of Brazil until 1960; Carnival, samba and bossa nova
f.today: Rio de Janeiro is the capital and largest city of the state of Rio de Janeiro and the second-largest city in Brazil after São Paulo.
